name: sgs/mega-aside
title: SGS Mega Aside
description: The optional side panel of a mega panel — media, a tag, a heading, text and a call-to-action. Its LAYOUT/GRID position (width, divider) is painted by the parent mega panel's style variant and colour scheme (CF-10, parent-paints-child); its own FILL (background, padding, corner radius, border) and content arrangement (asideFormat) are this block's own. Used inside sgs/mega-panel only.

aside.label: Aside
aside._note: The `.sgs-mega-aside` side-column wrapper. GRID POSITION (width, divider) stays parent-owned (CF-10: mega-panel's asideWidth/asideSeparator paint this element per data-mega-style/data-mega-scheme) — never duplicated here. FILL (background/padding/radius/border) is THIS block's own attrs, resolved against the panel's inherited --sgs-mm-* custom properties as safe fallbacks so an unset value still looks correct inside any panel scheme. `asideFormat` (feature|preview|cta) is a content-arrangement mode attr, not a css: property mapping (CF-4 pattern, mirrors mega-panel's variant/style), so it is deliberately absent from attrMap. Its content (media + tag + heading + text + button) is child-owned (HC2) — no typography/colour duplicate control lives on THIS block for any of those elements.

asideBgGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the aside background instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over asideBg at render time.

asideBgHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the aside background on hover instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over asideBgHover at render time.

asideBorderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the aside border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over asideBorderColour at render time (D636).
